facts.fact: WFP says its 2025 support included advancing integration of the Karamoja Social Registry into the National Single Registry, with discussions continuing with the Office of the Prime Minister and the World Bank's NUSAF team.
facts.system: Karamoja Social Registry / National Single Registry

facts.fact: The FY2026/27 Public Investment Plan lists NUSAF IV (project 1920, 7/1/2025 to 6/30/2030, UShs 44.798bn in FY2026/27) with the output 'National Social Registry with beneficiary data established', MGLSD leading its technical development under Subcomponent 3A and the registry to cover the whole country.
